title: LeetCode 1174 SQL Query Provider
content:
'''Utility module providing the SQL query for LeetCode 1174.

The original file was misnamed and contained raw SQL wrapped in C‑style
comments, which caused a SyntaxError when imported as a Python module.
This module now offers a clean Python interface that returns the required
SQL statement as a string.
'''


def get_delivery_counts_query() -> str:
    """Return the SQL query that solves LeetCode 1174.

    The query returns, for each `customer_id`, the `carrier_id` that has the
    highest number of deliveries.  Ties are broken by the smallest
    `carrier_id`.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        The formatted SQL query.
    """
    return (
        "SELECT customer_id, carrier_id\n"
        "FROM (\n"
        "    SELECT customer_id, carrier_id,\n"
        "           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, carrier_id ASC) AS rn\n"
        "    FROM (\n"
        "        SELECT customer_id, carrier_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt\n"
        "        FROM Delivery\n"
        "        GROUP BY customer_id, carrier_id\n"
        "    ) t\n"
        ") t2\n"
        "WHERE rn = 1;"
    )

title: leetcode_1174.sql
content:
/*
  LeetCode 1174 – Immediate Food Delivery
  This script creates the required schema, provides a sample data set, and computes the total tip
  assuming each order is started at its orderTime (the simplest feasible interpretation in pure SQL).
  The calculation follows the problem definition: tip_i - (deliveryTime_i - startTime).
  Here startTime is taken as orderTime for each order.
*/

-- 1. Create the orders table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    order_id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    orderTime     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    deliveryTime  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tip           INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- 2. Sample data (you can replace or extend this with the actual test cases)
INSERT INTO orders (order_id, orderTime, deliveryTime, tip) VALUES
    (1, 1, 3, 5),   -- tip earned: 5 - (3-1) = 3
    (2, 2, 5, 6),   -- tip earned: 6 - (5-2) = 3
    (3, 4, 6, 4),   -- tip earned: 4 - (6-4) = 2
    (4, 6, 9, 8);   -- tip earned: 8 - (9-6) = 5

-- 3. Compute the total tip assuming each order starts at its orderTime
SELECT
    SUM(tip - (deliveryTime - orderTime)) AS total_tip
FROM
    orders;

title: leetcode_570.sql
content:
SELECT e.Name
FROM Employee e
JOIN Employee r ON e.EmployeeId = r.ManagerId
GROUP BY e.Name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY e.Name;

title: leetcode_570.sql
content:
SELECT e.name
FROM Employee e
JOIN Employee d ON e.employee_id = d.manager_id
GROUP BY e.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY e.name;

title: leetcode_570.sql
content:
-- LeetCode 570: Managers with at Least 5 Direct Reports
SELECT e.name
FROM Employee e
JOIN Employee r ON e.id = r.managerId
GROUP BY e.id, e.name
HAVING COUNT(r.id) >= 5;
